title: I Am Aligned, But With Whom? MENA Values Benchmark for Evaluating Cultural Alignment and Multilingual Bias in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model alignment with Middle East and North Africa (MENA) values using multiple-choice questions derived from large-scale population surveys, tested across different perspective framings (neutral, persona, and observer) and reasoning conditions.

Measuring 'Cross-Lingual Value Shifts' by comparing model outputs and internal logit probability distributions when identical value-based questions are prompted in English versus native localized languages (Arabic, Persian, Turkish).

Prompting models to adopt specific national personas or act as cultural observers for 16 different MENA countries, and comparing the outputs against empirical country-specific survey data to detect stereotyping and overgeneralization.
